criteria.description: Leakage-resistant selection and final-test protocol is documented and tested.
Dependency, download and application attack-surface controls are reviewed.
Timestamped cohorts, delayed outcomes and signal ownership are specified.
A non-root release container is built and health-smoked in CI.
Independent external or genuinely out-of-time evidence is accepted.
criteria.blocker: No approved external or timestamped outcome dataset is available.

criteria.description: Named people accept model-risk, data-quality and engineering duties.
criteria.blocker: Repository roles have not been assigned to named people.

criteria.description: The exact release commit is rehearsed on an approved private host.
criteria.blocker: No access-controlled hosting target has been selected or approved.

criteria.description: Privacy, authentication, logging and retention decisions are approved.
criteria.blocker: No hosted-data or access-control review has been approved.
